map.为什么理想膜料≈√n？: Why is the ideal film material about √n?
map.单层增透使膜两界面反射相消的条件是膜折射率=√(n基×n空气)，故取几何均值。: A single-layer antireflection coating makes the two interface reflections cancel when the film refractive index = √(n_substrate×n_air), hence the geometric mean.
map.反射率越低越好？: The lower the reflectance the better?
map.算单层增透膜的理想折射率与残余反射率。: Compute the optimal refractive index and residual reflectance of a single-layer antireflection coating.
map.计算四分之一波长减反膜厚度，推荐减反膜/硬膜/防水膜层系组合方案: Compute quarter-wave antireflection film thickness and recommend layer combinations such as AR / hard / protective films
map.计算四分之一波长减反膜厚度，推荐减反膜、硬膜、防水膜等层系组合方案，用于光学镜片: Compute quarter-wave antireflection film thickness and recommend layer combinations such as antireflection, hard and protective films, for optical lens coating design and transmission optimisation.
map.评估膜系反射率是否达标。: Evaluate whether the film stack reflectance meets target.
map.透射越高、鬼影越少，但过低膜层薄难控，且可能影响硬度，综合取 <1% 实用。: Higher transmission means fewer ghost images, but too thin a film is hard to control and may affect hardness, so under 1% is practical.
map.高折射率基片选匹配膜料。: Choose a matching film material for a high-index substrate.
map.：单层只能某波长最优，宽波段用 MgF₂+高折交替多层把平均反射压到 <0.5%: : a single layer is optimal at only one wavelength; for a wide band use alternating MgF₂ and high-index layers to push average reflection below 0.5%, lowest in the green.
map.：基片 n=1.6 → 单层增透理想膜料 n=√1.6≈1.265；若用 n=1: : substrate n=1.6 → the ideal single-layer film is n=√1.6≈1.265; with a n=1.38 film the residual reflection R=((1×1.6−1.38²)/(1×1.6+1.38²))²×100≈0.75%, far below the ~5.3% of bare glass.
